event.title: A Convoy
event.text:
A transmission from The Colony Ship reaches you as your squad crosses into another people's space.
"We are not the only colony ship running from this. No single people can make the crossing alone, but a convoy might, each ship guarding the next. Ask the others to join us. Start with the ones who have already lost their homes: they have the least left to lose."

outcome.text: Your squad carries a new offer with it: a place in the convoy for any people who will fly beside the others.

event.title: The Azurethea and the Convoy
event.text:
An Azurethea elder listens to the offer of a place in the convoy without interrupting, wings folded, then answers softly.
"You are asking us to leave our home and trust strangers to fly beside us."

choice.text: Offer their people passage in the convoy.

outcome.text: "We have already learned to leave," the elder says. "We would rather leave together." The Azurethea pledge their colony ship to the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} promise that the convoy's shields will cover them.

outcome.text: {crew} speaks quietly of shells of light around every ship in the convoy. The elder lowers their wings. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} offer to keep their people's records.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, will keep the name of every Azurethea aboard, whatever happens on the way." The elder is silent for a long moment, then agrees. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy.
{crew} and the elder talk for a long time, in the quiet way of their people. When it's over, the Azurethea pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Ask them to leave a home that is still whole.

outcome.text: "Our home is still whole," the elder says gently. "Ask us again if that changes. We will remember that you asked."

event.title: The Tentauri and the Convoy
event.text: Two Tentauri answer your hail, their voices in step. "A convoy. Many ships, flying as one. Show us that you can fly as one."

choice.text: Fly a joint operation with them.

outcome.text: You cross the cluster beside them, your shields overlapping theirs. At the far side the two voices answer together: the Tentauri pledge to the convoy.
Raiders find you halfway across. The Tentauri hold their place beside you, and before the shooting starts they say it plainly: they will fly with the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} speak for the Azurethea already in the convoy.

outcome.text: {crew} tells them how gently the Azurethea fly, and how many of them the convoy already carries. The Tentauri pledge to it.
{crew} answers in the same soft voice. The two Tentauri do not need to hear more. They pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Ask them to leave a home that is still whole.

outcome.text: "We are whole here. We do not need to fly as one yet. Ask us when we do."

event.title: The Mecha and the Convoy
event.text: A Mecha yard boss hears the offer and laughs. "A convoy. And what do the Mecha get for guarding everyone else's ships?"

outcome.text: "Now it's a contract." The Mecha pledge to the convoy, for as long as it pays.

choice.text: Let {crew} show them what they gain.

outcome.text: {crew} lays it out in clipped Mecha code: every ship in the convoy needs repairs, parts and guns, and the Mecha would be the only yard in it. The yard boss likes those numbers. The Mecha pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Show them how many have already joined.

outcome.text: The yard boss counts the pledges twice. "Fine. Being left behind isn't profitable either." The Mecha pledge to the convoy.
"Come back with a better offer," the yard boss calls after you.

event.title: The Senti and the Convoy
event.text: A Senti archive station hails you, its light lines bright. "We, The Senti-, have recorded your offer. A convoy is a record that moves."

choice.text: Offer them the convoy's records to keep.

outcome.text: "Every people in it, kept safe. We, The Senti-, will fly with the convoy." The Senti pledge to it.

choice.text: Ask them only to keep the convoy's records.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, will not fly beside the living. We will keep what you are, and send a data ship to follow yours." The Senti pledge their archive to the convoy.
{crew} exchanges a single burst of data with the station. "I told them what the convoy is," {crew} says afterwards. The Senti pledge to it.

event.title: The Lykario and the Convoy
event.text: A Lykario packleader laughs at the offer. "Ride in a convoy, like prey? No. But a convoy draws prey, and someone has to hunt for it. Show us you're worth hunting beside."

choice.text: Accept a fair hunt against them.

outcome.text: "Good!" The pack comes for you, and it is not playing. Win, and they'll hunt for the convoy.
{crew} tells the story of your last fight, with a few details improved. The packleader grins. The Lykario pledge to hunt for the convoy.
{crew} talks pay, GATOS style: so much a jump for every raider the pack runs off. The Lykario take the first payment and pledge to hunt for the convoy.
"Come back when you want a real hunt!" the packleader calls.

event.title: The Malphen and the Convoy
event.text: A Malphen ship drifts across your path, silent and swollen. Nobody takes the Malphen in, and nothing about it suggests it wants a place in any convoy. But it could let the convoy pass.

choice.text: Jettison matter for it to feed on.

outcome.text: The ship gathers every scrap of what you dumped, slowly, and turns away. It will let the convoy pass. That is as close to a pledge as the Malphen ever come.

event.title: The GATOS and the Convoy
event.text:
A GATOS hub answers your hail.
"The convoy? The Colony Ship is GATOS. We were the first to sign."

event.title: The Ones Who Refused
event.text:
The rim is here. Behind you, the convoy is forming: every people that pledged. Ahead, across the way out, hang the ships of the ones who refused, or were never asked.
"There's room on that path for one convoy," their leader says. "It won't be yours."
The ships of your allies drop out of their jumps beside you.

choice.text: Tell them there is still room in the convoy.

outcome.text: Nobody answers. Their weapons come online.
Your squad's weapons come online, and your allies' with them.

event.title: The Rogue
event.text:
The rim is here, and every people that could be asked has pledged to the convoy. For a moment the way out is empty.
Then something vast and living uncoils across it: a Malphen ship that follows no pledge, grown huge on everything the collapse left behind.
The ships of your allies drop out of their jumps beside you.

outcome.text: It does not hail you. It never would.
